title: Desktop first-run: macOS blocking notifications greys out the sound and the test with the reason, and the step is not done until allowed
steps: S1: run the desktop notify-bridge/notify-permission tests and the tracy-onboard flow/mount/render tests (node:test, fake addon and fake bridge).
S2: the end-to-end form of this case is ST-8 in tests/acceptance/desktop-onboard-v2 (app from source, the addon faked through NODE_OPTIONS=--require, denied then allowed + focus).
expect: The bridge passes the system's answer (allowed/denied, else unknown) and reads it again when a window gains focus, pushing only a change.
denied: the amber card with Open System Settings; the sound picker and Send a test disabled with the reason, not hidden; the step not done.
Back allowed after System Settings: the step turns Done; unknown: the on-card says the permission cannot be read.

tests: macOS: status carries the permission the system reports
a window gaining focus reads the permission again
macOS: the addon answer is passed on, for each of its four values
macOS blocks notifications: amber card, test and sound disabled, step not done
notifications, macOS blocks them: the amber card with Open System Settings
notifications, permission unknown: the on-card says the permission cannot be read

fence: a denied permission disables (never hides) the sound and the test and keeps the step undone
